title: First-Order Methods for Solving Convex (Strongly) Concave Minimax Problems with Functional Constraints
summary: Minimax problems arise in many applications, including robust learning and Stackelberg models. Most existing methods for minimax problems address unconstrained or projection-friendly settings, while functional constrained minimax problems remain far less explored. We study a class of convex-(strongly-)concave minimax problems with functional constraints. By exploiting strong duality, we incorporate the inner-maximization functional constraints into the objective.
